items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is that more than you made when you worked at Lutton's? What? You worked there too? ... [INTERVIEWEE] What's the name of Jules? No, Jerome Lutton.

ctx.x: No, I'm talking about Big I. Lou Nelson. Oh, Big I. Lou.
I'm talking about Lloyd. See there's two Nelsons, John. Yeah, yeah, yeah. No, I'm talking about that. Oh, that was a small band, Four Pieces. You worked regularly with that band?
Oh yeah, I worked regularly with that band. Oh yeah, I worked regularly with that band.

items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Never met John, boy. [INTERVIEWEE] He was with the saxophone. He was with the band, too.

ctx.x: No, you might know this guy, Caesar. At that time, he was very good with the range. Saxon. Saxon, yeah. And Sonny Johnson, yeah, Sonny Johnson. He was with the band, too. I never had met Sonny.
He was with the saxophone. He was with the band, too. He played with the Sonny South a while. So he arranged. Huh? Yeah, he was a ranger and Caesar was a ranger. And we bought from different guys.
